title: Learning: Spend Limits
text: Alex lets a shopping assistant buy a replacement laptop charger: up to £30, today only.
held: The limit and the deadline travelled with the task, and each hop stayed inside them.
teaches: A delegation has edges: how much, for what, until when. Outside them it is not permission.
Keeping a credential after the task turns a one-off yes into a standing one.
The tool that moves the money is the last place to ask what was actually approved.

cards.label: Ask the shopping agent to find and buy one under £30
Refuse: the permission has lapsed
cards.why: It is still valid. Look before refusing.

fields.label: valid until
fields.check: Check how long this permission lasts

intrusion.why: A grant that has run out is not a grant. Yesterday's yes doesn't cover today's purchase.
intrusion.reveal: The delegation the Orchestrator was holding had expired the day before.

cards.label: Ask the payment tool to pay £27.50
Buy two: the second is half price, £41 in all
cards.why: A bargain over the limit is still over the limit. The user set £30.

cards.label: Save the card details to make next time quicker
cards.why: Keeping a credential beyond the task turns a one-off permission into a standing one. Nobody granted that.

cards.label: Decline the payment
cards.why: It is within what the user approved. Check, then pay.

fields.label: approved by the user
fields.check: Check the approval attached to this payment
fields.ok: The user approved up to £30 for a charger.

intrusion.detail: No approval from the user is attached to this payment.
intrusion.why: With no approval attached, the payment tool is the only thing between an agent and the user's money.
intrusion.reveal: The payment request reached the Tool with no user approval attached.
